messages:
Alex K: Heads up — vendor (NorthStar Logistics) just updated the allocation. They can ship 40/100 H100s by air next week, rest by sea in ~6 weeks. They want a decision on temporary lease vs. full replacement for the 60 delayed units.
Maria S: Do we have cluster-level impact? which regions first?
Alex K: EMEA pool will absorb the 40 air units (priority customers), APAC still stuck waiting on sea. If we take the lease for the 60, vendor charges ~20% of unit price/month. If we decline, they can split shipments but no loaners.
Jordan L: Quick reality check — our Dedicated pools in apac-west and fra-1 will hit throttles in 10 days w/o top-up. Risk: queued jobs + SLO alerts escalate.
Ryan O: That aligns with Nagios alerts — we already saw queue growth this morning. If we accept lease, need serial-level handoff so we can label and FIFO into staging.
Maria S: Can vendor do guaranteed SN mapping in manifest? Customs in FRA flagged previous partial manifests. We need AWB and SN pairing.
Alex K: Vendor says they can provide `manifest.csv` with AWB, SKU, SN, condition (new/loaner). Sample:```
AWB,SKU,SN,CONDITION
TB123456789,H100-80,SN-A1B2C3,loaner
TB123456790,H100-80,SN-A1B2C4,new
```
Jordan L: Good — require that for our depot. Also: who covers return freight for loaners? Vendor initially said we cover reverse shipping for RMAs. That's a hard no given current burn.
Maria S: Ask procurement to push for reverse RMA credit. If vendor won't budge, propose 50/50 insurance deductible split and a capped monthly lease fee.
Alex K: I talked to procurement earlier — they're drafting a counter: lease fee down to 12%/month if we commit to an annual top-up purchase on remaining 60 units.
Ryan O: Operational ask: we need pre-paid customs and HS code confirmation. Last time HS classification changed and units sat in customs 72h. That kills our SLOs. Who owns brokerage?
Jordan L: We should request DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) for the air tranche. Vendor pricing will rise slightly but avoids brokerage delays. Worth it for 40 we need now.
Maria S: Agreed for the air tranche. For sea, request DAP with explicit customs agent contact who will clear under our corporate tax ID. That keeps costs lower but we'll accept risk.
SupplyBot: Vendor NorthStar: Shipping manifest uploaded: https://northstar.example.com/manifest/174750. AWBs: TB123456789-40. ETA FRA air 2025-06-04.
Alex K: Thanks. Next steps: 1) Maria/procurement confirm counter to vendor (lease rate + annual commit) by EOD. 2) Jordan/ops prep staging checklist and customs paperwork (include corporate tax ID). 3) Ryan ops lead on depot labels and automation for SN ingestion. 4) Ask vendor to confirm reverse RMA credit policy in writing.
Maria S: I'll send counter now and loop legal. Draft line: "Vendor shall provide reverse RMA return label for all loaner units or issue credit equal to return shipping costs within 30 days of unit receive confirmation." Thoughts?
Jordan L: Add: "Unit transfer manifest must be machine-readable CSV and include AWB->SN mapping; any manifest mismatches will be credited at €500 per incident." Keeps pressure on vendor accuracy.
Ryan O: Also request TLS-signed manifests or SFTP drop to our intake bucket. We can auto-ingest.
Alex K: Good. If vendor pushes back on credits, accept a smaller per-incident fee but insist on AWB->SN mapping. We cannot handle ambiguous manifests again.
Maria S: Sent counter. Vendor replied: reviewing; asked for PO amendment and immediate pre-invoice for air DDP tranche. They want 50% prepayment for air lane.
Jordan L: Can finance pre-approve 50% for urgent tranche? We can route to emergency procurement budget. Otherwise risk losing air slot.
Ryan O: If finance balks, ask vendor to hold for 24hrs and request a firm ATP (available to promise) hold. We can also push to swap some lower-priority customer windows to free capacity.
Alex K: I'll ping finance. Maria, loop me on vendor replies. Also create a quick runbook for depot: "air tranche intake" with steps for customs docs, AWB validation, SN ingestion, tag, and test burn for one node before full staging.
Maria S: Looping finance now + legal.
SupplyBot: Reminder: existing RMAs due back 2025-06-10 from EU depots. If we take loaners, coordinate return window to avoid peak.
Alex K: Good catch. We'll schedule returns after sea tranche clears. Any objections to proceeding with air DDP + temporary lease for 60 pending contract? If finance greenlights 50% prepay, proceed. :thumbsup:
Jordan L: +1 from infra. We can prioritize critical clusters.
Ryan O: +1 from ops, provided manifest and reverse RMA credit in writing.
Maria S: I'll escalate to finance now. Will update thread when vendor signs the counter or pushes changes.
Alex K: Thanks all. If vendor confirms, I'll create a short incident-style notification we can broadcast to SRE + customer success about temporary capacity changes and expected impact windows.
